critical_code_review_comments: ensure_reservation_lock_indexes correctly drops any legacy index on locked_until (observed only _id_ and locked_until_ttl remain in Mongo), so the IndexOptionsConflict/'SCALP SERVICE BLOCKED' startup failure mode is retired.

/api/admin/acceptance/bundle enforces step-up: without TOTP it returns 403 code=mfa_enrollment_required (not a soft error); the demo_readiness manual tick + bundle generation path records step_up_verified=True in the audit row (verified via unit lane in test_fixplan_main98.py).
Crypto live_enabled stays false in the preview per policy; /api/crypto/status is a public GET on this build (requires session cookie) and returns {live_enabled:false, default_testnet:true}.

BotConfig PPNumInput now implements the specified draft pattern: internal string state during focus, parent numeric state applied only on blur with the default fallback — avoids the 'select-all + type 2 → 12' prefix-merge bug and empty-value jank.
